Pizza in Hongdae: 72-hour dough and a Vesuvio volcanic-stone oven

When choosing oven-baked pizza in Hongdae, look at the dough and baking process as well as the toppings. Hongdae Hwaduk Pizza (홍대화덕피자) ferments its dough for 72 hours, cooks the sauce in-house and bakes pizzas briefly at high heat in its Vesuvio volcanic-stone oven.

Compare the actual pizza and dough

Looking for Neapolitan-style pizza? Compare actual photos of the puffed rim, dark baked spots, the centre with its cheese and toppings, and the pizza inside the oven. Try a bite of the rim separately, then taste the centre with the toppings to compare the textures. The preparation confirmed here is 72-hour dough fermentation, sauce cooked on site and baking in our volcanic-stone oven. Oven material alone does not make all pizzas the same style; compare the actual food and the toppings you prefer.

Choose toppings and plan your visit

For cheese-forward toppings, consider Quattro Formaggi; for varied toppings, look at Quattro Stagioni or a half-and-half pizza. Check the latest menu and prices on Naver Place. It is about five minutes on foot from Hapjeong Exit 6 or Sangsu Exit 1 and about fifteen minutes from Hongik University Station. Select Reservation on Naver Place to check available times for your party.

An Italian example of volcanic-stone use

Italian oven maker Marana Forni says it uses volcanic stone from Mount Vesuvius in the material blend for its Napulé pizza oven, developed with Neapolitan pizza makers. It is an Italian example of the use of stone from the same volcano as the stone in our oven.
